profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
•  Full stack software engineer with experience developing an open-source application in collaboration with tech accelerator, OSLabs, that measures server performance of Next.js applications

•  Experienced in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express, NoSQL (MongoDB), SQL (PostgreSQL), HTML5/CSS3

•  Recent talks include concepts on GraphQL at a Tech Talk Series sponsored by Jeeny and Bractlet

•  Strong customer-focused mindset with eight years of experience as product manager in a major South Korean chemical company, overseeing all aspects of the product value chain

✨ Visit my GitHub page: https://github.com/sjk06

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Developed a React-based monitoring dashboard using reusable components to swiftly display server-side performance metrics, utilizing React hooks (useState, useContext) to achieve simple and efficient state management by streamlining access to shared data across multiple components and pages

•  Integrated React Router library to support nested routing and enhance user experience with intuitive transitions between pages

•  Built dynamic charts using Recharts.js for seamless integration with React and enable user interactivity to re-render charts based on user-customized date and time periods and hovering to observe specific data values

•  Utilized Tailwind CSS to streamline development process of creating responsive designs to support diverse window sizes and browsers, simultaneously minimizing the CSS file size for faster page loads 

•  Implemented a PostgreSQL database storing vast amounts of real-time metrics data and supporting advanced queries handling filters such as user-specified pages and date/time periods

•  Employed observability framework, OpenTelemetry, to collect telemetry data

•  Published developer tool as an npm package to facilitate installation and dependency management

positions.title: Callstack | Social media platform for software developers
positions.description:
• Integrated Redux for efficient state management, establishing a centralized store to reuse data across different components and streamline handling of complex state changes, including the creation, modification and deletion of posts and comments

•  Utilized Express to construct RESTful APIs, defining routes for efficient handling of HTTP requests and creating reusable middleware for enhanced modularity across components

•  Employed MongoDB as the database solution, ensuring efficient data storage and retrieval for optimal application speed and performance
positions.insights: Node.js, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +6 skills

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
•  Led sales expansion efforts by promoting products and services to commercial and production teams of new and existing customers, achieving 180% increase in global sales volume over 3 years

•  Collaborated with production engineers to devise optimal procurement, production, and inventory plans in line with monthly, quarterly, and yearly sales targets

•  Responded to customers’ product complaints with quality control engineers by investigating sampling and testing methods, identifying causes for differing test results, and taking necessary remedial actions

•  Coordinated with logistics engineers to ensure preparation of products, equipment and documents at docks and vessels

•  Partnered with R&D team researchers to review viability of alternative products and specifications for customers

•  Established and maintained close communications with customers to strengthen business relationships and facilitate smooth monthly price negotiations
